decisions.reason: The candidate already records the source message's button and knob styling, while bowl measurement markings were already required. Bowl lighting is independently represented by REQ_LED_LIGHTING.
The silver treatment applies specifically to buttons and knobs and is already represented under control styling; it does not change the machine's primary, accent, or referenced enclosure colors.
Bowl lighting and silver DJ-style controls implement the existing DJ-inspired theme but do not change this candidate's visual theme or desired visual character.
The source decision does not alter the placard's title, position, viewing orientation, display sides, or wording.

The request to explore an E treatment may merely reaffirm the existing E markings or may soften the prior mandatory cursive-E specification into an exploratory decision; the intended state change is not clear enough for propagation.
Requiring bowl lighting does not explicitly change the specified simultaneous loads or required power headroom, and any electrical-capacity adjustment would require additional design evidence.
Lighting and measurement units around the bowls do not change bowl depth, capacity, or refill acceptability.
The source decision concerns controls and bowl decoration, not the spout's appearance, material, or fabrication method.
Bowl lighting and visual measurement units do not alter the dispensing path, flow behavior, dripping constraints, or beverage-preservation requirements.
The visual additions around the bowls do not necessarily change the existing splash-control target or mitigation measures.
The source decision does not change whisk dimensions, material, selected design, powder compatibility, or bowl-capacity assumptions.
The bowl-lighting decision does not affect whether the spout is removable or its cleaning purpose.
